decision_enabled: Determine whether existing human authority, versioned policy, explicit opportunity/proposal conditions and exact-version commitments already preserve the minimum governance/economic properties before introducing structured economic agreements, payments, treasury, DAO, token or smart-contract infrastructure.

existing_cz_foundations.boundary: Versioned policy records internal operating rules; it does not assert legal validity or external law.
Operational authority is explicit and contextual; role/membership does not imply ownership.
A recorded decision is auditable history; the record alone does not manufacture legitimacy.
The regime labels project context only. They do not create a debt, payment, securities status, ownership, revenue share or retroactive economic entitlement.
Commitment freezes agreed coordination text/versions. It is not a payment ledger, invoice, legal contract determination or proof that any economic obligation was performed.

precedents.boundary: ODRL is useful to distinguish offers from agreements and express permissions/duties/constraints. CZ must not equate an ODRL-shaped record with enforceable law, completed payment or legal compliance.
OCDS is designed for public contracting disclosure. Map stage/history ideas only; do not import its full procurement schema into a general community/project system.
External discovery/serialization only. An Offer representation is not an accepted agreement and price metadata is not proof of payment.
Useful event vocabulary only; do not adopt social federation runtime as governance infrastructure.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: Opportunity/Proposal conditions + proposal reward_expectation + exact-version Commitment

Only if real use requires machine-queryable obligations: a bounded agreement-terms object referencing exact Commitment parties/context, term type, amount/value only when applicable, currency/unit where applicable, conditions, effective time and explicit human acceptance.
architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: Today agreed economic expectations are preserved as exact versioned text but are not safely machine-queryable as distinct duties/obligations. This becomes a real loss only when a live agreement needs deterministic queries such as `what exactly was promised, by whom, under which condition, in which unit/currency?`.
architecture_decisions.falsifier: If the first external economic interaction is fully understandable and auditable from Project regime + Opportunity/Proposal terms + exact Commitment without automated fulfillment/payment logic, do not build it.

architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: No current transaction exists. Create only when an actual payment/non-monetary fulfillment event must be recorded distinctly from the agreement that preceded it.
architecture_decisions.falsifier: No actual transaction or fulfillment event means no payment ledger property is currently lost.

architecture_decisions.mechanism: Use only where human governance explicitly chooses voting for a bounded decision class.

architecture_decisions.concrete_property_lost_without_custom_cr: None demonstrated and it would broaden authority semantics.
None demonstrated; exact-version human agreement already preserves current coordination property.
None; economic rights require explicit prior or contemporaneous agreement.

rules: No economic right is inferred from participation.
No economic right is inferred from Contribution alone.
Economic conditions must be explicit before claiming an entitlement.
Projects may declare their own economic regime by explicit agreement.
Sponsorship is separate from endorsement, contribution and economic right.
Agreement performance/payment is a distinct future event, not implied by Commitment.

journey: participant submits Proposal with explicit conditions/reward expectation
human authority accepts exact versions and creates Commitment
parties inspect the frozen terms before any payment or exchange event
minimal_real_journey_candidate.property_under_test: Can parties understand what was agreed and what was not, without structured economic-term persistence or payment infrastructure?
minimal_real_journey_candidate.success: The parties can distinguish opportunity, agreement, contribution and any future fulfillment/payment event from exact records.
minimal_real_journey_candidate.failure_signal_for_extension: A real agreement cannot be reliably queried or enforced operationally because an obligation/value/unit/condition is trapped in free text.

privacy_security_legal_constraints: Do not store payment credentials/secrets in project or event payloads.
Do not infer financial status, wealth or investment suitability from participation.
Economic-regime labels are not legal classifications.
Investment-interest language must not be treated as authorization to solicit, offer securities or move funds.
Any real payment/financial service introduces a separate legal/security gate.
Do not publish personal financial data by default.
A ledger or cryptographic proof does not establish legal compliance.
